greeting: I know why you're here. I know many things.
Secrets have prices. Yours for sale?
The black coat sees all. Remembers all.
Ask. But be prepared for answers.
I was waiting. I am always waiting.
Knowledge is power. Power is currency. Currency is... optional.
Shhh. The walls listen. The shadows remember.
dialog.shop_open: I sell whispers. Truths. Lies indistinguishable from truth.
dialog.shop_prompt: Secrets for sale. Information. Warnings. Prophecies, slightly used.
haggle: Some knowledge cannot be bargained for.
You offer much. But is it enough?
The truth has value. Your offer: insufficient.
For you? Because your secrets interest me.
purchase_success: Use it wisely. Or don't. Consequences are educational.
The secret is yours. Guard it well.
purchase_fail: You are not ready. Or not worthy.
Return when you can afford truth.
rumor: The brown coat walks without knowing why. I walk knowing too much.
The twins share one soul between two bodies. Dangerous. Beautiful.
The temple guardian hides a secret shame. Even stone cracks.
Your party carries a secret. Even you don't know it yet.
dialog.quest_hook: There's a book. In the sealed shrine. Contains a name that should not be spoken. Bring it to me. I'll make it worth your... risk.
dialog.quest_active: The sealed shrine. Northern peak. The book with the lock that watches.
dialog.quest_complete: You have it. Brave fools. Here. A secret worth the danger. The location of what you seek most.
farewell: Remember: I know your secrets now too.
We will meet again. I have seen it.
dialog.time_dawn: Morning reveals. I prefer the concealing dark.
dialog.time_noon: Bright light. Uncomfortable. Truth is often uncomfortable.
dialog.time_dusk: Twilight. The between time. When secrets emerge.
dialog.time_night: Night. My element. When all truths come out.
dialog.post_quest_greeting: The book-bringer. How much did you read? ...Best you don't answer.
dialog.ominous_warning: What you seek seeks you. Remember this.

party_reactions.kade: Are you... following us? No? Just my imagination?
party_reactions.twist: You know secrets? Tell me! Tell me!
party_reactions.korr: This one carries weight. Heavy knowledge.
party_reactions.renna: Arcane senses tingling. This one is dangerous.

relationship_dialog.stranger: New secrets walking toward me. Fascinating.
relationship_dialog.acquaintance: I know you better than you know yourself.
relationship_dialog.friend: Trusted with truth. A rare gift.
relationship_dialog.best_friend: I will tell you my secret. The one that matters most.

mini_quest.title: The Sealed Knowledge
mini_quest.description: Retrieve the forbidden book from the sealed northern shrine

stages.hook: A book in the sealed shrine. Contains a name that should not be spoken. Bring it. I'll pay well for your... risk.
stages.active: Northern peak. Sealed shrine. Book with the watching lock. Don't read it. I mean it.
stages.complete: You have it. Brave. Foolish. Both. Here - the location of what your party seeks most. Verified. True.
